subject: Go-live readiness: delegation & risk compact for CedarPoint pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@cedarpointhealth.com>, Mark Hale <mark.hale@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CedarPoint pilot — SOW + quick summary for CS takeover

Team — looping you in to transition CedarPoint Health (pilot -> production). Quick summary and asks: 

Deal at a glance:
- Account: CedarPoint Health (regional outpatient chain)
- Expected go-live: 2028-07-15 (pilot -> phased prod)
- Committed usage: ~120M tokens/month first quarter; concurrency peak ~12 RPS (short prompts, 1–2k tokens/window)
- Pricing: agreed (see SOW v3 attached); procurement expects final PO next week

Key open items / risks:
1) Network & allowlist — customer needs our egress IPs on their firewall (attachment: network_requirements.csv).
2) SSO/SAML integration — CedarPoint requests Okta SAML; they want test environment access by 6/20.
3) Data residency question — they prefer US-only; contract language OK but we need to confirm deployment mode (hosted vs private).

Suggested owners (initial):
- Onboarding lead: Marissa Cole (CS) — primary contact for PM/ops/enablement
- Infra & deployment: Vivek Kulkarni — infra/Private deployment feasibility and VPC setup
- Tech lead: Karthik Iyer — integration, telemetry, and performance tuning
- Customer success sponsor: Tessa Morgan (you) — escalation and SLA owner

Attachments: CedarPoint_SOW_v3.pdf, Handoff_Checklist_cedarpoint.xlsx, network_requirements.csv

Immediate asks for CS before our internal kickoff 6/5 11:00 AM PT:
- Marissa/Vivek: confirm owners and availability for kickoff
- Karthik: 1–2 bullet notes on whether they need private deployment for US-only residency
- Tessa: confirm PM cadence (weekly) and readiness to take primary relationship

Alyssa/Mark (cc'd): please confirm the Ops contact and any blackout windows for July. Procurement mentioned they should send PO by 6/10.

Thanks — Jordan
--
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@cedarpointhealth.com>, Mark Hale <mark.hale@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint pilot — SOW + quick summary for CS takeover

Thanks Jordan — I’ll take ownership of the account-level escalation and stakeholder cadence. Quick responses and next steps from our side: 

Assignments (confirmed):
- Marissa Cole: Onboarding lead & PM (owner for runbooks, training, acceptance)
- Vivek Kulkarni: Infra lead (VPC, network allowlist, private deployment feasibility)
- Karthik Iyer: Technical integration lead (API, batching profile, telemetry/events)

Questions I need answered before the 6/5 internal kickoff: 
1) Can you confirm expected average RT per request and token distribution across short/long prompts? Jordan — the 120M tokens number helps but we need token-per-request estimates for batching guidance.
2) Who is the Ops contact at CedarPoint for firewall/allowlist coordination? (Jordan — Alyssa is cc'd; would be great to get direct contact + phone.)
3) Are there any custom compliance requirements (DLP, data retention beyond our standard) we should know about?

Proposed internal kickoff: 6/05/2028 11:00 AM PT — 45 min. Agenda: owners, SSO timeline, network plan, staging access, acceptance criteria + success metrics. I’ll create calendar invite after confirmations.

I’ve pulled the SOW and checklist into our shared drive (link below). Marissa — can you own the activation checklist and create the initial sprint (3-week pilot readiness) in Jira? Vivek — please review network_requirements.csv and confirm any blocked items by 6/4 so we can escalate if needed.

Thanks — Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Internal: ext. 457 | tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
From: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Hale <mark.hale@cedarpointhealth.com>, procurement@cedarpointhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint pilot — SOW + quick summary for CS takeover

Tessa and team — thanks for the clear notes. Quick confirmations: 

- Ops contact: Mark Hale (cc'd) will be the technical point-of-contact for network and SSO. Phone: +1 312-555-0147.
- Procurement: we expect the PO to be issued by 2028-06-10; I’ll confirm when it’s sent.
- Blackout windows: no maintenance windows in July; pilot traffic can be scheduled Mon–Fri 8a–6p CT but we’ll coordinate a narrow migration window for go-live.

I’ve attached our network requirements spreadsheet with our current firewall team notes (see network_requirements.csv). SSO/Okta will be handled by our Identity team — they’ll need a test SAML metadata file and a staging URL by 6/20.

We’re excited to get started — see you on 6/5.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Barnes | Director, Digital Services | CedarPoint Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint pilot — SOW + quick summary for CS takeover

On Thu, Jun 1, 2028 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Deal at a glance:
> - Committed usage: ~120M tokens/month first quarter; concurrency peak ~12 RPS

Thanks — a few technical notes from my side: 
- Token breakdown: assuming 1.2k tokens/req average gives ~100k requests/month; that aligns with expected concurrency. If they have lots of short prompts, effective batching will reduce cost but we'll need to tune payload windows.
- Deployment mode: if CedarPoint needs US-only residency and strict VPC isolation we should plan Private (customer-managed VPC) evaluation. Vivek — can you confirm whether Dedicated capacity would also meet their compliance needs vs Private?
- SSO: I can stand up a staging SAML endpoint for testing once we have Okta metadata.
- Acceptance metrics: propose: (1) <500ms median token latency for short prompts in staging, (2) functional parity for top-10 prompt templates, (3) basic telemetry events logged to their SLA analytics endpoint.

I’ll prepare a short tech-readiness memo and batching recommendations before the 6/5 kickoff.

-Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-06-05T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff summary & owner milestone commitments (CedarPoint pilot)

Team — recap from the 6/5 internal kickoff + assigned next steps (short bullets for clarity).

Owners & immediate milestones:
- Marissa Cole (Onboarding lead) — Create pilot activation sprint in Jira by 6/06; owner of runbook, training deck, acceptance test plan; D0: initial sprint items created.
- Vivek Kulkarni (Infra lead) — Network allowlist validation and VPC feasibility assessment by 6/09; provide recommended migration path (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private) and estimated lead times.
- Karthik Iyer (Tech lead) — Deliver tech-readiness memo and batching suggestions by 6/07; provide baseline telemetry schema for CedarPoint.
- Tessa Morgan — Stakeholder cadence & escalation plan: weekly 30-min status with CedarPoint (starting 6/12); 1 executive check-in pre-go-live (7/10).

Open blockers we will escalate if not cleared by their due dates:
- SAML metadata from CedarPoint Identity (target 6/14) — if not received, we cannot complete full SSO test in staging.
- PO from Procurement (expected 6/10) — finance to confirm billing account setup after PO receipt.

Next internal check-in: 6/09 10:00 AM PT to validate infra findings. I’ve created the Jira epic and added sprint placeholders (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REDWOOD-CP-4582).

Attachments/links: Handoff checklist, SOW v3, network_requirements.csv, hubspot/deal link.

Thanks all — please update the Jira epic as you complete your milestones so I can roll status up to the exec sponsor.

Best,
Tessa
